messages:
dave.sre: Heads-up: during next maintenance window (Tue 2026-04-06 03:00-04:00 UTC) we're going to recalibrate generation API SLOs and run a short preload stress test for us-east-1. Goal: tighten SLO headroom and validate prefix-warmup heuristics.

maria: can you summarise the SLO changes?

dave.sre: TL;DR: move gen-api P99 target from 900ms -> 750ms for standard tier (non-dedicated) in us-east-1 only. This is a policy change (SRE/Product agreed) that will be rolled out gradually and monitored during the test window.

josh: what "gradually" means in practice?

dave.sre: rollout plan: 1) preflight config on canary pool (2% traffic) for 10 min, 2) 10% ramp for 15 min, 3) 50% for 20 min, 4) complete to 100% if metrics stable. We'll run a controlled preload generator during the 10/15/20min windows to exercise cold-path and kv-warmup.

ops-bot: Note: automated incident detection will open a pager if gen-api error-rate >0.4% OR P99 delta >250ms over baseline for 10m.

maria: I'll add dashboards: gen-api-p99-by-tier, kv-warmup-hitrate, fallback-count, admitted-queue-length. Will set alert thresholds to the abort criteria.

dave.sre: Abort criteria (manual + automated): sustained P99 increase >250ms for 10m, or error-rate increase >0.4% absolute, or model-fallback-count >50/min. If abort -> rollback SLO flag and kill preload job.

josh: preload command we'll use (internal):
```
curl -X POST https://internal-loadgen/redwood/preload -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"region":"us-east-1","route":"/v1/generate","qps":1200,"duration_s":900,"prefixes":["/gen-cache/","/user-ctx/"]}'
```
I recommend enabling KV prefix warmup before the 2% canary starts.

dave.sre: Agreed 12 we'll run warmup 5m before canary and again between ramps. Also note: deploy-bot will create a dedicated job id.

deploy-bot: preload job created job_id=preload-2026-04-06-us-east1-1945011111-canary, canary=2%.

infra-bot: Capacity check: gpu pools us-east-1 standard have 18% spare headroom. Memory pressure nil.

product-ops: Do we need any external customer comms?

dave.sre: Not proactively. If we hit abort and customer-visible errors persist >5m we'll post to #status with guidance. Product-ops, please stand by to escalate if needed.

maria: Who's owner during the window?

dave.sre: I'll own the rollout. Josh will handle warmup/kvcache tuning. Maria will watch dashboards and own the pager channel. On-call rotation will remain primary for paging.

josh: I'll have a CLI helper to lower admission thresholds if we see queueing: `scripts/tune_admission --region=us-east-1 --decrease=10`

dave.sre: Post-rollout tasks: 1) commit SLO config to repo, 2) update public SLO doc and internal runbook, 3) follow-up retro if we abort. Link to draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/slo-config/pulls/92

product-ops: noted. We'll prep a short status blurb to be ready.

dave.sre: final note: this is a policy change (tightening SLO) so expect a few incidental fallout tickets from app teams that rely on the old envelope. We're intentionally limiting to us-east-1 to iterate quickly. If anyone wants to opt their service out of the canary, DM me before Mon 23:59 UTC.

ops-bot: Reminder set: 1h before window (2026-04-06 02:00 UTC).

dave.sre: thanks all. I'll post the final runbook snippet and exact job ids in this thread 30m before start.
